output.title: New Vault issuer server-name option; no Vault issuer in supplied inputs
output.content: The release note describes a new feature: config added to the Vault issuer that lets you set the server-name used to validate the certificates the Vault server presents. Nothing in the supplied inputs shows a Vault issuer. The manifests contain only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate (no Issuer or ClusterIssuer), the only installed CRD is certificates.cert-manager.io, and none of the values keys relate to Vault. Because the note describes new config that "allows" a setting, it reads as an addition, but this rests only on the supplied inputs: if issuers are managed outside these manifests, check whether any of them use Vault before you rule this out.
